sentences.text: Bus Stop is a 1956 American romantic comedy film directed by Joshua Logan for 20th Century Fox , starring Marilyn Monroe , Don Murray , Arthur O'Connell , Betty Field , Eileen Heckart , Robert Bray and Hope Lange . Unlike most of Monroe 's movies , Bus Stop is neither a full-fledged comedy nor a musical , but rather a dramatic piece ; it was the first film she appeared in after studying at the Actors Studio in New York .	Actors Studio	Actors Studio	Bus Stop	Bus Stop (TV series)

Monroe does however sing one song : `` That Old Black Magic '' by Harold Arlen and Johnny Mercer .	That Old Black Magic	That Old Black Magic (song)	Harold Arlen	Harold Arlen	Johnny Mercer	Johnny Mercer
Bus Stop was based on two plays by William Inge , People in the Wind and Bus Stop .	William Inge	William Inge	People in the Wind	People in the Wind	Bus Stop	Bus Stop (TV series)
The inspiration for the play Bus Stop came from people Inge met in Tonganoxie , Kansas .	Bus Stop	Bus Stop (TV series)

In the 1961 -- 62 season , ABC adapted the play and film into a television series of the same name , Bus Stop starring Marilyn Maxwell as the owner of the bus station and diner .
